claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Contact Other Plane as always prepared. The v4 atom grant_spell_access exists but ClassFeatureEffect only includes GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect — no grant_spell_access variant exists there.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you always have the Contact Other Plane spell prepared

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_free_spell_cast (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The once-per-long-rest activation grants a slot-free cast of a named spell. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant can express 'cast a specific spell without expending a spell slot'. This is a new effect shape: a named-spell free-cast triggered by the feature's use_count.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast the spell without expending a spell slot to contact your patron

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_save_auto_succeed (modifier on named-spell cast)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants automatic success on Contact Other Plane's INT saving throw when cast via this feature. The closest v4 atom is modify_roll_substitute, but no surface shape exists for 'auto-succeed' on a specific spell's cast-time save within a ClassFeatureEffect context.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw
